data.one_liner: A Flutter package for easy implementation of a curved animating bottom navigation bar.
data.what_it_does: Provides a curved bottom navigation bar widget with smooth sliding animations for switching items. It supports custom colors, heights, animation curves, and can be controlled programmatically using a GlobalKey.
use_when: You want a modern, curved bottom navigation bar with a floating active button effect
You need an animated navigation bar with customizable colors and transition durations
avoid_when: You require a standard Material Design BottomNavigationBar matching platform guidelines
You need more than 75.0 height for the navigation bar
strengths: Smooth built-in animations with customizable curves and durations
Supports changing pages programmatically via GlobalKey
weaknesses: Height is limited to a maximum of 75.0
Limited to a bottom navigation bar layout style
